name: message-bubble
title: Message bubble
description: A chat bubble for people talking to people: own and other styles, grouped corners, a reply quote and a send state.
docs: Put the bubbles in a plain block, in order; each brings its own spacing, tight inside a run and wider between runs. side is own (right, primary surface) or other (left, muted); position says where the bubble sits in a run from one person (single, first, middle, last) and squares off the corners that touch their neighbours, so work it out from the neighbouring messages. time is written as a clock time in locale and timeZone under the last bubble of a run, with the exact moment in its tooltip; every bubble keeps its time for screen readers. For your own messages status shows in words as well as a mark: Sending, Sent, Read, and Not sent with a Retry button when you pass onRetry. A failed message shows its state wherever it sits in a run, and pressing Retry hands focus to the line that then says Sending. replyTo quotes the message being answered, attachments draws images or files inside the bubble above the text, and author adds the avatar at the end of a run and the name at its start. Long words and URLs wrap, and line breaks in a string are kept.
